Glamour by Neha — Bridal Makeup & Hair, Delhi-NCR

Glamour by Neha is a Delhi-NCR bridal makeup studio known for HD and airbrush
bridal looks, draping services, and trial sessions. The lead artist has a strong
social-media following and a recognizable "soft glam" signature style.

Pricing: a 2022 price list shows the bridal package (engagement + wedding day)
at ₹45,000. A 2024 booking inquiry auto-reply quotes ₹75,000 for the same
package, while a third-party listing still advertises ₹45,000. With multiple
conflicting figures and no clearly current rate, confirm the present price in
writing before booking.

Contact: +91 98110 64422 · bookings@glamourbyneha.example
Location: Greater Kailash, Delhi
Rating: 4.7 / 5 (188 reviews)

What couples say:
"My bridal look lasted the entire 12-hour day without touch-ups."
"The trial session helped us nail exactly the look I wanted."
"Lovely team and very calming on a stressful morning."

Glamour by Neha offers a paid trial that adjusts against the final booking and
travels to nearby cities for destination weddings on request.
